items.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
items.summary: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.

items.title: Amazon’s Zoox expands its robotaxi service to Las Vegas airport
items.summary: Zoox is expanding to this critical ride-hailing destination a few weeks after it started charging for robotaxi rides.

items.title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt, bringing together founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations on what it takes to build and scale.

items.summary: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
items.summary: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

items.title: Google spared from ad-business breakup, but judge orders changes to how it operates
items.summary: Google has dodged an effort to break up its ad business, but a judge said Wednesday that the company will need to adjust its business to benefit competitors.

items.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
items.summary: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.

items.title: MapQuest is now the No. 1 US app after bucking Trump’s ‘Lake America’ renaming
items.summary: The once-dominant mapping app has surged to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store after refusing to adopt Trump’s “Lake America” name, drawing more than half of its 2026 U.S. downloads in just six days.

items.title: It sure looks like hackers breached a major ID card verification service
items.summary: An identity theft search site claimed to have more than 150 million driver's license photos stolen from an ID verification service. The crime site has now shut down.

items.title: Delivery Hero board backs Uber’s $15B takeover bid
items.summary: If approved, the combined company would become one of the largest food delivery platforms in the world.

items.title: Enhanced geothermal notches another win as Google buys 400 MW from Fervo
items.summary: Fervo's deal with Google could expand to 1 gigawatt of geothermal power, enough to supply a very large AI data center in Utah.

items.title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
items.summary: Wonderful said it will use its $550 million Series C funding to develop products faster, expand its FDE teams, and meet demand for its products.

items.title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
items.summary: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.

items.summary: Security companies are scrambling to build products that can monitor not just agents but also the tools and add-ons they use.

items.title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
items.summary: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.
